name.zh: Tomb Raider Game of the Year

summary: 《古墓丽影》探索了劳拉·克劳馥紧张的起源故事，以及她从年轻女人变为坚强生存者的成长过程。
summaryEn: Tomb Raider explores the intense origin story of Lara Croft and her ascent from a young woman to a hardened survivor.
